name: Sakura Riches 60

features.name: Lantern wilds
features.description: Substitute for all symbols except the scatter.

review:
A serene Asian game – drifting sakura petals, hand fans, lotus flowers – with Chinese lanterns as the wild, on 60 lines.

BGaming keeps the description short, but the numbers say a lot: very high volatility, a 3,000x max and a 97.16% RTP. It looks calm and plays swingy, so give it some demo spins to see how the scatter feature behaves before judging it.
pros: Excellent 97.16% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
